steps.expr: (() => { const svg=document.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) return JSON.stringify({ok:false,why:'no svg'}); const tn=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent.includes('THUNDER')); const bn=tn?tn.getBBox():null; /* chevron group = g containing stroke paths only, transform has translate+rotate+translate(0 -7) */ const rg=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g')].filter(x=>{const t=x.getAttribute('transform')||''; return t.includes('rotate') && t.includes('translate(0 -7)') && x.querySelector('path');}); const rbb=rg.length?rg[0].getBBox():null; const nameMid=bn?+(bn.y+bn.height/2).toFixed(1):null; const rankMid=rbb?+(rbb.y+rbb.height/2).toFixed(1):null; return JSON.stringify({ok:!!bn, nameMid, rankMid, deltaY: rbb&&bn?+(rankMid-nameMid).toFixed(1):null, nameBbox: bn?{y:+bn.y.toFixed(1),h:+bn.height.toFixed(1)}:null, rankBbox: rbb?{y:+rbb.y.toFixed(1),h:+rbb.height.toFixed(1)}:null}); })()
